-- =====================================================
-- FIND CHESTS С ФИЛЬТРОМ ВЫСОТЫ
-- =====================================================
function FindAllChests()
    local result = {}
    
    local playerPos = Character and Character.PrimaryPart and Character.PrimaryPart.Position or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    local groundY = playerPos.Y
    
    for _, obj in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        local part = nil
        local prompt = nil
        local name = ""
        
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
            part = obj
            prompt = obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt")
            name = obj.Name:lower()
        elseif obj:IsA("Model") then
            prompt = obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
            part = obj.PrimaryPart or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            name = obj.Name:lower()
        end
        
        if part and prompt and prompt.HoldDuration <= 25 then
            if part.Position.Y - groundY <= MAX_HEIGHT then
                local found = false
                for chestName, keywords in pairs(chestNames) do
                    if chestTypes[chestName] then
                        for _, kw in ipairs(keywords) do
                            if name:find(kw) then
                                table.insert(result, {
                                    Prompt = prompt,
                                    Position = part.Position,
                                    Part = part
                                })
                                found = true
                                break
                            end
                        end
                        if found then break end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return result
end

-- =====================================================
-- FREEZE
-- =====================================================
local function EnableFreeze()
    isFrozen = true
    FreezeBtn.Text = "❄️ Freeze: ON"
    FreezeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 200)
    
    if Humanoid then
        pcall(function() Humanoid.PlatformStand = true end)
    end
    
    local hrp = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hrp then
        pcall(function()
            local bv = hrp:FindFirstChild("FreezeBV") or Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            bv.Name = "FreezeBV"
            bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
            bv.P = 10000
            bv.Parent = hrp
        end)
    end
end

local function DisableFreeze()
    isFrozen = false
    FreezeBtn.Text = "❄️ Freeze: OFF"
    FreezeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
    
    if Humanoid then
        pcall(function() Humanoid.PlatformStand = false end)
    end
    
    local hrp = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hrp then
        pcall(function()
            local bv = hrp:FindFirstChild("FreezeBV")
            if bv then bv:Destroy() end
        end)
    end
end

FreezeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if isFrozen then DisableFreeze() else EnableFreeze() end

-- =====================================================
-- KILL ALL
-- =====================================================
function KillAllMobs()
    local killed = 0
    for _, obj in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") then
            local isPlayer = false
            for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if obj == plr.Character then
                    isPlayer = true
                    break
                end
            end
            if isPlayer then continue end
            if obj == Character then continue end
            if obj.Name and obj.Name:lower():find("chest") then continue end
            if obj.Name and obj.Name:lower():find("crate") then continue end
            local hum = obj:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                pcall(function()
                    hum.Health = 0
                    hum:TakeDamage(1000000000)
                    killed = killed + 1
                end)
            end
        end
    end
    if killed > 0 then
        killedCount = killedCount + killed
        KillCountLabel.Text = "Killed: " .. killedCount
    end
end

function KillLoopFunction()
    while killMode do
        KillAllMobs()
        wait(1)
    end
end

KillBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    KillAllMobs()
end)

KillLoopBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    killMode = not killMode
    if killMode then
        KillLoopBtn.Text = "Loop ✓"
        KillLoopBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 160, 40)
        KillStatus.Text = "KILL ALL: LOOP ON"
        KillStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
        spawn(KillLoopFunction)
    else
        KillLoopBtn.Text = "Loop"
        KillLoopBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
        KillStatus.Text = "KILL ALL: OFF"
        KillStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
    end
end)

-- =====================================================
-- AUTO FARM (wait(0.3) между циклами)
-- =====================================================
spawn(function()
    while true do
        if isRunning then
            local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
            local character = player.Character
            if not character then
                wait(Settings.FarmDelay)
                continue
            end
            
            local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not humanoidRootPart then
                wait(Settings.FarmDelay)
                continue
            end

            local chests = FindAllChests()

            if #chests > 0 then
                table.sort(chests, function(a, b)
                    return (humanoidRootPart.Position - a.Position).Magnitude < (humanoidRootPart.Position - b.Position).Magnitude
                end)

                for _, target in ipairs(chests) do
                    if not isRunning then break end

                    if target.Prompt and target.Prompt.Parent then
                        if target.Position.Y - humanoidRootPart.Position.Y <= MAX_HEIGHT then
                            humanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(target.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                            wait(Settings.TeleportInterval)

                            pcall(function()
                                fireproximityprompt(target.Prompt)
                            end)
                            wait(Settings.CollectionInterval)

                            collected = collected + 1
                            BigCounterLabel.Text = "CHESTS: " .. collected
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        
        -- 🆕 Задержка 0.3 сек между циклами фарма
        wait(Settings.FarmDelay)
    end
end)
